method: Read complete byte bodies and recursively resolve every include, produce a complete quote/comment-aware call census, then distinguish executed calls/dynamic SQL from pg_get_functiondef/to_regprocedure string inspection and follow the actual critical native claim/drain/reader bodies. This is a source safety decision, not native runtime acceptance.
harnessRequirements: One outer BEGIN with REPEATABLE READ for snapshot-guard includes, ROLLBACK and a fresh absence/fingerprint connection.
Repository release expansion must remove nested verifier transaction boundaries and conflicting psql ON_ERROR_STOP controls; never execute raw included ROLLBACK as the outer close.
Exclude containing roots whenever an included body is excluded; do not approve a root by checking only its own visible calls.
Fixture-only direct DML/mocks do not prove real queue/settlement/payment business behavior; retain those acceptance gates separately.

verifiers.reason: Only catalogue, definition-string/constraint/ACL/trigger metadata inspection and hashes; referenced business functions are not invoked.

Isolated Candidate account/workflow/Contract-week fixture; executes exact preview/reject/delete SQL owners. The rejection inserts a Candidate notification record; SQL does not send email or perform R2 deletion.
Data-free helper vectors or null/authenticated negative admission and catalogue/ACL checks. Browser/invalid-input calls refuse before business owners; no actual financial or communications effect.

Rollback upload/stage/seal/publication fixtures and exact replay/CAS refusals. Native projection publication writes Source comparison/query intent data; no dispatch claim/send or payment/settlement executor is invoked.
Rollback Source context, stage/rows/seal/publication and Office recheck fixtures; no queue claim/drain, provider or financial payment execution.
Rollback projection mapping/issue/lineage fixtures. Included key capture installs temporary counter/key triggers; no external effects or queue processor.

Executed pg_temp claim loops invoke actual Source message command and target claim owners; they can lease real hosted rows before filtering to fixture. This is dispatch queue processing, although SQL rollback prevents durable leases and no Worker sends mail.

Executed paid-fixture helper calls public.pay_workbench_dirty_apply_jobs_chunk, the actual job claim/apply processor. Candidate-bound fixture filtering does not change the prohibited queue-processing action.

Rollback Source preparation/finalisation/charge-accept fixtures. Source economic and billing authority plus entitlement preparation are transaction-contained SQL; no payment-provider submission, settlement recording, message claim or job drain is called.
